name: Hotel Pension Huter
beschreibung: Hotel Pension Huter is situated in a peaceful yet central location in Söll within the Wilder Kaiser holiday region. The valley lift station and direct access to the vast SkiWelt ski and hiking area are easily reached on foot or by the local ski bus. Accommodations feature traditional alpine styling, with many rooms offering private balconies facing the Wilder Kaiser massif. Amenities include a breakfast buffet, an on-site sauna and steam bath, and ski storage.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Pension Huter in Söll in the Wilder Kaiser region offers quiet alpine lodging, a sauna and steam bath, balcony rooms, and easy SkiWelt access.
